shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "pwd && rg --files -g '"'!node_modules'"' -g '"'!package-lock.json'"' -g '"'!yarn.lock'"' -g '"'!pnpm-lock.yaml'"' -g 'AGENTS.md' -g 'package.json' -g 'src/**' -g 'app/**' -g 'pages/**' -g 'index.html' -g 'vite.config.*' -g 'tsconfig.json' -g '.agents/skills/gravity-ui/**'"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,100p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md; rg -n -C 3 'navigation|table|icons' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md; cat package.json; cat src/App.tsx; cat src/main.tsx; cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md"

/bin/bash -lc '.agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Button TextInput Select Checkbox Modal DropdownMenu Pagination; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/README.md | head -100; cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/icons.md'
